summary.text: Staci Childs is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 131 in the November 3, 2026, general election, running against Republican Scott Whitmarsh in a race with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Childs described being a Houston attorney, former Houston ISD Teacher of the Year and elected member of the Texas State Board of Education representing District 4.

paragraphs.text: Childs was born in Atlanta, Georgia, and graduated from Benjamin E. Mays High School.

Childs earned a bachelor's degree from Hampton University in 2009, a graduate degree from Georgia State University in 2011 and a J.D. from Thurgood Marshall School of Law at Texas Southern University in 2018.
Ballotpedia lists a career that includes owning a private legal practice and working as an attorney and a language arts teacher, and says Childs runs the nonprofit GirlTalk University.

In the survey, Childs said that years teaching elementary students in Southwest Houston and Sunnyside preceded law school, and that Childs now runs Sunnyside Legal, representing teachers, families and other Texans.
Childs said that on the State Board of Education the work has focused on protecting Black history in classrooms and securing tutoring and intervention funding for struggling campuses.
